async def act(page):
    # Click on the Customers link in the menubar to open its dropdown menu
    customers_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Customers')
    await customers_link.click()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click on the 'Customer Groups' link in the dropdown menu to navigate
    customer_groups_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Customer Groups')
    await customer_groups_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    return
